discoveries.name: Original display labels
discoveries.decision: Display labels are not evidence of Shiva identity.

discoveries.name: Oesho / Vayu / Shiva / Ommo
discoveries.decision: Oesho remains independent. Iranica linguistic identification differs from iconographic cataloguing. Ommo coin passage unavailable; no family transfer.

discoveries.name: Batara Guru / Bhatara Guru / Siwa / Manikmaya / Girinata
discoveries.decision: First three are reviewed Balinese usages. Manikmaya and Girinata remain unresolved Javanese portrayal names; independent Javanese record and primary family verification unfinished.

discoveries.name: Sang Hyang Tunggal, Dewi Rekatawati, Antaga/Togog, Ismaya/Semar, Dewi Uma, Nandini; Sambu, Brahma, Indra, Bayu, Wisnu, Kala
discoveries.decision: Javanese family and mount leads from the Batara Guru encyclopedia. Existing javanese_semar is independent. Not imported into Bali or mapped by spelling to Hindu records. Indra overlap reserved to Sakra.

discoveries.name: Manuk Patia Raja, Debata Asi Asi, Sori Pada, Mangala Bulan, Siboru Porti Bulan, Mula Songta, Mula Songti, Siboru Sorba Jati, Deak Parujar, Odap Odap
discoveries.decision: Batak contextual family leads; examine existing Batak records and scholarly passages before adding claims.

discoveries.name: Sang Patotoqe, Datu Palingeq, La Togeq Langiq, We Nyiliq Timoq, Sangiang Serri/We Oddang Nriuq, Batara Lattuq, Sawerigading; We Saung Nriuq, We Leleq Ellung, Apung Talaga, Tenritalunruq, Apung Ritoja; La Pangoriseng, La Temmalureng, La Temmalolo, La Lumpongeng, La Pattaungeng, We Temmaraja, La Tenriepeng, La Temmaukkeq, La Sappe Ilek, La Tenrioddang
discoveries.decision: Unsourced Bugis encyclopedia section is a lead, not validated genealogy. No new targets selected.

discoveries.name: Bathou/Bathau brai, Mainao/Bhulli Buri, Asu Mainao, Sali Mainao, Ai-Deo, Song Raja/Song Brai, Bura Bagh Raja
discoveries.decision: First six usages grounded in Endle; named local cult associates are not inferred relatives. Ai-Deo identity is unresolved. Existing names Sibrai/Jiu/Siu and modern daughter tradition need separate evidence.

discoveries.name: Paruhang/Pārū Hāng/Lord of Flowers, Sumnima, Hetchhakuppa, Nayuma/Marima
discoveries.decision: Paruhang and Sumnima registered; other inherited local names and family/clay-animation claims remain awaiting passage verification. Rai is not a synonym for every Kirati community.

discoveries.name: Mahakala, Daikokuten/Daikoku, Okuninushi; Bai Black Sky God; Tibetan Mahakala
discoveries.decision: Japanese chain linked through registered Daikokuten. Bai and Tibetan records are independent contexts, not universal aliases. Their own families and traditions remain open.

discoveries.name: Yashimajinumi / Yashimamuji; Waka-hirume; Heavenly-Pass-Boundary
discoveries.decision: First pair are distinct people in the two Kojiki genealogies. Waka-hirume is qualified by the descendant context pending homonym study. Translated Heavenly-Pass-Boundary name retained rather than invented native script.

discoveries.name: Ikochini / Hina-teri-nukata-bichi
discoveries.decision: Kojiki XXVI note11 marks a corrupt maternal sequence. Variant retains both conjectures; no parent target invented.

discoveries.name: Kura-mitsuha; Iha-saku, Ne-saki, Iha-tsutsu-no-wo, Mika-haya-bi, Hi-haya-bi, Take-mika-dzu-chi/Take-futsu/Toyo-futsu; Ma-saka-, Odo-, Oku-, Kura-, Shigi-, Ha-, Haya-, To-yama-tsu-mi; Ame-no-wo-ha-bori/Itsu-no-wo-ha-bori
discoveries.decision: Kojiki VIII co-manifested deities and sword names are not biological siblings/parents of Kura-okami. Broader entity resolution is unfinished; no inferred family edges.

discoveries.name: Maruts; Suyasa’s unnamed sons/grandsons; forefathers; Sanaka/Sanatkumara; Jaya, Vijaya, Bhrngin
discoveries.decision: Collectives, unnamed descendants and narrative associates kept distinct. Maruts belongs to overlapping Indra research; do not equate to Vayu’s Marut alias. Sanaka and companions are witnesses/curse agents, not inferred family.

discoveries.name: Radha (Goloka) / Radha (Karna foster-mother); Visvarupa Prajapati / other Visvarupa figures
discoveries.decision: Explicit context-qualified new IDs prevent name collision; no runtime matching or inherited family.

discoveries.name: Sadashiva, Nilalohita, Rudra, Ardhanarishvara, Nataraja, Mallikarjuna, Bhairava/Kalabhairava/Kalaraja; Dakshinamurti, eleven Rudras and further incarnations
discoveries.decision: Reviewed forms linked or retained as same-record names. The Rigvedic portrayal and narrated Bhairava manifestation have explicit records. Further forms and their textual variants remain research, not automatically additional people.

discoveries.name: Oath, spouse and manifestation passage inventory
discoveries.decision: Ichiki-shima-hime/Sa-yori-bime, Tagi-tsu-hime, Ta-kiri-bime/Oki-tsu-shima; Suseri-bime, Yakami-hime, Ki-no-mata/Mi-wi, Nunakawa-hime all have explicit endpoints. Five jewel-born male oath children remain contextual discoveries: Ame-no-oshi-ho-mimi, Ame-no-hohi, Amatsu-hiko-ne, Iku-tsu-hiko-ne, Kumanu-kusubi; no guessed endpoint or imported family. Kartikeya carriers and six unnamed wives other than Arundhati are not biological parents. Mahakali portrayal retained on existing Kali; fevers/humours not inferred children. Nandi narrative locations Jatodaka, Trisrotas, Vrishadhvani, Svarnodaka, Jambunadi, Panchanada/Japesvara are places, not people.

discoveries.name: Nihongi I additional names
discoveries.decision: Iso-takeru/Isaoshi, Oho-ya-tsu-hime, Tsuma-tsu-hime, Sukuna-biko-na/Sukuna-hiko-na, Oho-mono-nushi, Mizo-kuhi-hime/Tama-kushi-hime and Hime-tatara I-suzu-hime have explicit records. Susa-no-yatsu-mimi has conflicting parental gender/context in adjacent accounts; retained as a textual discovery rather than merged with Ashinazuchi or Tenazuchi. Suga-no-yu-yama-nushi/Mitsu-na-saro-hiko and alternate long child names require independent identity review. Ama-no-Fuki-ne is a named distant descendant, not an invented intermediate parent. Kuye-biko and tani-guku are narrative informants, not family. Clan Kimi of Kamo/Oho-miwa are not converted to individual gods.

discoveries.name: Accessible collateral research
discoveries.decision: Oath daughters and Okuninushi spouse narratives now implemented from Kojiki XIII–XIV and XXI–XXV; Kartikeya’s carriers and Virabhadra’s manifestation are now cited. Nihongi direct parentage and generation variants, Ukanomitama and Sukunabikona conflicting parents, tree-planting children, Miwa cult portrayal and Isuzuhime accounts are now implemented. Kartikeya regional spouses, further Shiva forms, and legacy powers/objects/rituals throughout the frontier still require passage review. These are unfinished work, not access blockers.
